info.title: TripKing API
info.description: Outstation cab marketplace REST API. Wire format is snake_case; every response uses the envelope { success, data, meta?, error } (meta on lists, error non-null on failure). This document currently covers the /admin/* master-data endpoints (Phase 2); the marketplace endpoints follow in Phase 3.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Administration master-data (the configurable lookup tables — see §7 of the spec).

tags.name: drivers
tags.description: Driver profiles + the "create my driver/agent profile" route.

tags.name: vacancies
tags.description: Driver availability posts (driver is in city X, willing to drive to one of these destinations).

tags.name: alerts
tags.description: Saved searches that fire a notification on a matching trip/vacancy (owner-scoped).

tags.name: analytics
tags.description: Server-computed analytics — the platform dashboard (admin), per-agent analytics, and the API-metrics rollup (admin).

tags.name: places
tags.description: Maps-backed locations — a server-side geocoder proxy (search) and find-or-create for a places row.

id.name: id
id.description: Row key — uuid for most lists, the value int for seat-options, the BCP-47 code for languages.

BearerAuth.description: Supabase access token from POST /auth/verify-otp. Authenticated endpoints validate it; every mutating /admin/* call additionally requires users.role === 'admin'.

get.summary: The current user (Bearer)

List trips - each row carries the assigned driver (with live position) + the joined from_place/to_place. status=in_progress&posted_by_user_id=<me> is a trip manager’s live-trips map; assigned_driver_id=me (Bearer) is "the trips I’m driving"; in-progress trips also get distance_to_destination_km. When near_lat+near_lng+radius_km are all given, the list is restricted to trips whose pickup point (from_place → from_city fallback) is within radius_km (capped at 100), nearest first, each row carrying distance_km.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: one value or a CSV (e.g. open,has_applicants)

parameters.name: assigned_driver_id
parameters.description: a driver uuid (public), or the literal "me" - needs a Bearer; resolves to the caller’s driver profile (the trips assigned to you)

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: radius search - all three of near_lat/near_lng/radius_km must be present

post.summary: Post a trip (Bearer) - from_place_id / to_place_id accepted alongside from_city_id / to_city_id (both coexist; *_place_id is the new primary path; a bad place id → 422); total_fare computed if omitted; driver_payout via trigger; matching active alerts get an alert_match notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

get.summary: My applications (driver; Bearer) — the caller's own trip_acceptances, newest first, each with its joined trip (from/to city, car type). The poster-only GET /trips/{id}/applicants is for the other side; this is the driver's view of where they've applied. Empty array if the caller has no driver profile.

Get a trip — joined (assigned driver with live position; distance_to_destination_km when in_progress). passenger_otp_hash is always stripped; the plaintext passenger_otp is echoed ONLY when the caller is the trip poster (Bearer; auth.uid() = posted_by_user_id) or an admin — so the poster can re-open the passenger-portal link any time.
List applicants (poster/admin)

post.summary: Apply to a trip (driver) — per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess)
Reject an applicant (poster/admin)
Assign a driver (poster/admin)
Start the trip (assigned driver) — verifies OTP
Complete the trip (assigned driver)
Cancel the trip (poster/admin)

get.summary: List vacancies (public) - joins driver+vehicle summary, current_city/current_place, and destination cities + places (vacancy_destinations: [{ city, place }]). When near_lat+near_lng+radius_km are all given, restricted to vacancies whose current point (current_place → current_city fallback) is within radius_km (capped at 100), nearest first, each row carrying distance_km.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: radius search - all three of near_lat/near_lng/radius_km must be present

post.summary: Post a vacancy (driver; Bearer) - driver_id = the caller; current_place_id accepted alongside current_city_id; destination_place_ids and/or destination_city_ids → vacancy_destinations rows (a bad place id → 422); matching active alerts get an alert_match notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

get.summary: Get a vacancy

post.summary: Cancel a vacancy (owning driver/admin; Bearer)

get.summary: List my alerts (Bearer) - joins from/to city + from/to place

post.summary: Create an alert (Bearer; user_id = caller) - from_city_id required; from_place_id / to_place_id accepted alongside from_city_id / to_city_id (a bad place id → 422). Posting a trip/vacancy inside the alert’s radius (and matching its other filters) fires an alert_match notification to the owner. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

notify_via.description: only in_app is delivered today; push/sms/email are recorded but no-op. An alert that doesn’t include in_app gets no notification yet.

get.summary: Get an alert (owner/admin; Bearer) - joins from/to city + from/to place

patch.summary: Update an alert (owner; Bearer) - partial; include from_place_id/to_place_id and/or is_active/paused_at to pause/resume (a bad place id → 422)

get.summary: List reviews (published rows + the caller's own when authed; admins see all). flagged=true (admin) = the moderation queue

parameters.name: flagged
parameters.description: admin only — return is_flagged rows (the moderation queue)

post.summary: Post a review (Bearer; rater_user_id = caller) — the trip must be completed; unique (trip_id, direction); ratee_user_id derived from the trip if omitted; fires a review_received notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).
Report a review (any authed user; Bearer) — sets is_flagged + flag_reason

get.summary: Get a review (published, or own, or admin)

patch.summary: Move a driver through the KYC workflow (admin; Bearer) — fires a kyc_status_change notification
Move an agent through the KYC workflow (admin; Bearer) — fires a kyc_status_change notification

post.summary: Moderate a review (admin; Bearer) — set is_published and/or clear the flag; records moderated_by/moderated_at

get.summary: Platform dashboard (admin; Bearer) — server-computed counts/sums (users by role, drivers by KYC, vehicles by eligibility, trips by status, completed-fare/commission sums, flagged reviews, monthly trip series, …)
Agent analytics (Bearer) — the caller's own, or ?user_id=<id> for admins. Trips posted/by-status, fare totals, applicants received, unique drivers used, reviews received, a 6-month series.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: admin only — a specific agent's user id (defaults to the caller)

get.summary: API metrics rollup (admin; Bearer) — per-endpoint request count, error count (status >= 500), avg/max/p95 latency over the last `hours` (default 24, max 720), plus the window bounds.

Geocoder search (public) — server-side proxy to the configured provider (PLACES_PROVIDER + PLACES_API_KEY; biased to India). Does not persist. Per-IP rate-limited; responses carry Cache-Control. data is an array of { provider, providerPlaceId, name, formattedAddress, state, lat, lng }. Returns [] when the provider is unconfigured or upstream is unavailable; q shorter than 2 chars → [].

post.summary: Find-or-create a place (public) — match by (provider, providerPlaceId), else by a ~5dp lat/lng + provider match; otherwise insert. Returns the stored Place (snake_case row, incl. id). Per-IP rate-limited.

get.summary: Get the caller's own driver profile (Bearer; joined like /drivers/{id}). 404 if the caller has no driver profile yet.
Get the caller's own agent profile (Bearer; joined like /agents/{id}). 404 if the caller has no agent profile yet.

Get the trip for a passenger OTP (public — the passenger portal) — joins the assigned driver (with live position) + vehicle; distance_to_destination_km when in_progress; fare fields nulled when show_fare_to_passenger is false; passenger_otp_hash never echoed
